console.g_basics_d.back: A few things the AI needs to know before answering calls for you.

console.f_language_h.back: Language AI uses to talk with callers

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: Language of notifications and summaries you read. Does not affect the language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only needed when a phone has a SIM from another region: calls to that SIM open in the language you pick here. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Not set: all calls start in the language above

console.f_owner_h.back: Name callers call you by; the AI uses this name when referring to you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names callers call you by

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: English name, nickname, etc., one per line, up to 10, so the AI knows it means you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: States it's your AI assistant and takes messages

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without agreeing to anything for you

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key from the Google AI Studio webpage

console.f_model_h.back: Model the AI uses to talk. Usually no need to change.

console.f_voice_h.back: Preview plays 3 spoken sentences in the language selected above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and hung up immediately; to let the phone ring normally, use "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the app

console.f_ring_h.back: Let it ring briefly before picking up like a real person. 0 = answer immediately.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Shortly before time is up, the AI wraps up politely and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Warm up AI while phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: AI speaks right upon answering. If off, callers wait 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers with hidden numbers talk to the AI as usual. Off: plays an unavailable announcement and hangs up.

console.f_barge_h.back: AI stops speaking and listens when the caller interrupts; some phone models may not support this, and Bageo checks automatically

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller finishes speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. If off, the system checks voice loudness instead.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to that language.

console.f_status_h.back: A short note about right now, like where couriers should leave parcels. AI mentions it only when relevant to the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Delivery: leave parcels at the building office

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds soft ambient sound behind the AI voice so it sounds like a real person answering

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when a caller is clearly trying to sell or scam.

console.f_stall_h.back: AI acts interested and asks for details to waste time, giving no info and agreeing to nothing. Off: AI declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max.back: Max duration for this call type

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Blank = use the same model as normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: Answer a few short questions so the AI sounds like you (optional).

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, replaces speaking style and local familiarity. Saved separately per answering mode. Use {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: Built from your saved language, answering mode, and name. Save first if you just edited them.

console.p_replace_body.back: There is already text in the edit box. It will be replaced with the built-in prompt.

console.f_knowledge.back: Info AI can use to answer

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave at the building office. Hours: Mon to Fri, 9 am to 6 pm

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts callers might ask about, one topic per line; AI won't make up anything not written here

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when declining calls from the blacklist or hidden numbers. Manage the blacklist in "Contacts".

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to block all numbers with the same prefix, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, excluding leading 0)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play unavailable announcement, then hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement speaks in the language selected above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Get notified when a call comes in and receive a summary after hang-up.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: sends no messages to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels yet. Add one to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In groups, specify who can send commands or nobody can. In private chats, leave blank. Check your ID via @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: Enable "Accept commands from this chat" in a notification channel above first

console.rc_env.back: Accept commands in Telegram chat configured via system variables

console.rc_env_h.back: Bot and chat use TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID environment variables, while TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS restricts who can send control commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI errands per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls from chat; max 30

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token in your AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: Allow ordering AI to place calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Allow, but ask me in chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: "Ask me first" requires a chat with commands enabled.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: Counted across all AI tools, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for web-based AI tools: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave blank.

console.n_test_ok.back: Sent. Check whether you received it.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste bot Token. Chat ID: ask @userinfobot for yours, or use group ID and add the bot to the group. Message the bot once so it can message you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter Webhook URL (Channel settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy Webhook URL) or bot Token plus Channel ID. For DMs, put your ID in Channel ID. Chat commands: enter bot Token and Channel ID, and enable Message Content Intent.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an incoming webhook link (works with Mattermost too) or enter bot token plus channel ID. Chat commands (Slack only): enable Socket Mode, then enter bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-), and channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console -> your Messaging API channel: issue a Channel access token and copy your User ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify ended in 2025; use this instead.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Pick a hard-to-guess topic name and subscribe in ntfy. Leave server blank for ntfy.sh; Token is only for password-protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps -> Create application and copy Token. Server URL is your Gotify server address.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on iPhone and copy the device key from the example URL. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an app at pushover.net to get an API token; your User key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In WeCom group: add a group bot and copy Webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings -> Bots -> Add custom bot and copy Webhook URL. If security is set to "Sign", paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings -> Bots -> Add bot -> Custom bot, then copy Webhook URL. Do not enable signature verification

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan site

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), sender account Access token, and joined room ID (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and app password (Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App passwords), not your normal password.

console.hint_apprise.back: Apprise API server notify URL, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. Use tags to limit which services get messages.
